command: pre-registration: R1 CAG-VA + empty-instruction probe, design frozen, before any rollout

metrics.H1: CAG(w*) > zs on the 15 recombination tasks of fresh_m1: more successes and exact two-sided sign test; p = 1 if w* = 1
metrics.H2: empty instruction completes a demonstrated same-scene training placement goal in > 0.25 of its episodes on the 19 evaluable dev tasks; one-sided two-level cluster bootstrap p (B 10000, seed 0)
metrics.H3: CAG(w*) mean success change over the 10 training cells vs parity base >= -0.01; estimate gate
metrics.disclosure: M1/FM zs numbers on fresh_m1 known; no CAG / empty rollout before R1; serving smoke on libero_90:14 stored states 0-1 excluded; articulated atoms not recorded (placement goals only)
metrics.secondary: every w vs zs (rec / part / all, by bin); fm_types failure types; instead rates (zs failures, empty, CAG failures; shares object / target); empty success on cells vs parity (vision shortcut) and on dev tasks; zs type agreement with results/fm/types
metrics.states: dev fresh_r1 BASE 6700000 seed 13; test fresh_m1 BASE 5700000 seed 13 (zs = M1's rollouts); cells stored 0-19 seed 0
metrics.w_star: argmax dev-set (fresh_r1) successes on the 15 recombination tasks over w in {1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5}; ties to smaller w
metrics.written_before: any R1 rollout on fresh_r1 / fresh_m1 / cells and any R1 read
